_README: The validation campaign's input, schema v2xw/validation-campaign/1. Copy this file
to docs/site/generated/validation-runs.json and have the validation suite fill in
`observed` and `outcome`; the generator reads it and the campaign page joins it
against the model registry and the defect registers.
EVERY ROW BELOW IS `not-run`, AND THAT IS NOT A PLACEHOLDER. The cases are the ones
04-models.md §13 defines, with the targets and tolerances that document states. What
has not happened is the measurement. Filling in an `observed` value that nobody
measured would be fabricating a validation result, which is the one thing this whole
page exists to make impossible, so the rows ship as `not-run` and the campaign page
`outcome` is one of: pass, fail, disabled, not-run. `disabled` is for a case whose
TARGET is unverified — §13 carries those as disabled rows rather than deleting them,
so the report shows what is missing instead of showing a shorter list.
Underscore-prefixed keys are ignored by the generator; this block is one.
Fields per case: id and models are required; statistic, scenario, target, tolerance,
tolerance_kind, observed, source, seeds, plan_digest and note are optional and the
page reports which were omitted rather than inventing them.

cases.statistic: pdr per 25 m distance bin, pooled over seeds
cases.note: 04-models.md §13 records this target as UNVERIFIED — the full text was never retrieved — so the case is carried disabled. The +-5 percentage-point tolerance is §13's own design choice for a digitised PDR curve, recorded there rather than cited.
§13: no numeric table found and the secondary figure is inaccessible. The case emits the curve for later comparison, which is why it is disabled rather than absent.

cases.statistic: SNR at 10 % PER, 400 B payload, 6 Mbit/s, AWGN
cases.source: Sjoberg et al., Atheros 802.11p chipset, cabled AWGN (R1 §C.2), via 04-models.md §4.7
cases.note: The model predicts 6.6 dB at 400 B against a measured 11.5, so real hardware needs about 5 dB more; the `sjoberg-atheros` preset sets rx_impl_loss_db to 5 dB for exactly this. Running the case is what decides whether the preset closes the gap.

cases.statistic: capacity, critical density, jam density, wave speed and capacity drop on a closed single-lane ring
cases.source: 04-models.md §2.9's fundamental-diagram targets; the harness is v2xw_mobility::fd
cases.note: The one case in this file whose harness already exists and whose targets are all cited. It is `not-run` because nothing has run it, not because anything is missing.

cases.statistic: signed SPDU size for a digest signer and for a full-certificate signer, bytes
cases.source: 04-models.md §9.1's envelope derivation, corrected by build decision D12.1
cases.note: A zero tolerance, because this is an encoder against an arithmetic derivation and not a model against a measurement. D12.1 records that the PSID three-byte threshold in the derivation was wrong (256, not 128) and that the encoder was right — which is what a validation case is for.
